minutes_from_rth_open.canonical_definition: Elapsed session minutes from the canonical RTH opening bell (08:30:00 US/Central).
minutes_from_rth_open.availability_timestamp: Checkpoint timestamp ts_init (end of completed 1s observation bar).
minutes_from_rth_open.inclusion_exclusion_boundary: minutes_from_rth_open <= 380.649994 includes trades from 08:30:00 to 14:50:39 CT; excludes the final 14 minutes 21 seconds of the RTH session (up to 15:15:00 CT).

realized_range_15m_atr.canonical_definition: Rolling 15-minute high-low range normalized by the incumbent regime's frozen starting ATR.
realized_range_15m_atr.numerator_definition: rolling_15m_high - rolling_15m_low across completed 1m bars (rolling window = 15, min_periods = 1).
realized_range_15m_atr.source_bars: Completed 1m bars resampled from CME 1s bars.
realized_range_15m_atr.rolling_window_semantics: Trailing 15 completed 1m bars up to the latest completed 1m bar prior to or at checkpoint ts.
realized_range_15m_atr.atr_denominator: frozen_atr (the Wilder ATR(14) recorded by DualEmaRegimeTracker at the confirmation bar of the incumbent regime).
realized_range_15m_atr.atr_snapshot_timing: Frozen at regime confirmation / start; does not float during the regime.
realized_range_15m_atr.completed_bar_availability: Strictly prior completed 1m bar (zero lookahead into forming bar).

current_price_from_prior_mfe_atr__tf_1m.canonical_definition: Signed distance from current checkpoint price to the maximum favorable excursion (MFE) of the immediately preceding completed 1m regime, normalized by current completed 1m ATR.
current_price_from_prior_mfe_atr__tf_1m.sign_convention: direction * (checkpoint_price - prior_regime_mfe). Signed positive when current price extends further in the current regime direction than prior regime MFE.
current_price_from_prior_mfe_atr__tf_1m.prior_regime_definition: The immediately preceding confirmed and completed regime on the completed-bar 1m DualEmaRegimeTracker.
current_price_from_prior_mfe_atr__tf_1m.prior_mfe_definition: The extreme price achieved in the prior regime's direction before it flipped. Defaults to start price / 0.0 if first regime of session.
current_price_from_prior_mfe_atr__tf_1m.atr_denominator: cur_1m_atr (the latest completed 1m Wilder ATR(14) from DualEmaRegimeTracker).
